page.help.clusters: A cluster is a group of backend service nodes. Routes forward requests to specified clusters. Click a row to expand node details and bound plugin capabilities.
page.help.routes: Routes define how requests are matched and forwarded to backend clusters. Path patterns support wildcards like /api/**. Click a row to expand forwarding config and bound plugin capabilities.
page.help.plugins: Plugins provide extended capabilities (rate limiting, WAF, retry, etc.). Enable globally, then bind to routes or clusters.
page.help.pluginResources: This page shows runtime resource usage and request statistics for each plugin. Data is collected automatically as requests flow through the gateway.
page.help.logs: Real-time logs show requests flowing through the gateway. Filter by level, status code, or route. The proxy log plugin must be enabled to record logs.
page.help.circuits: Circuit breaker monitoring shows the breaker state for each cluster. When backend services fail, the breaker trips to protect the system.
page.help.settings: System settings include interface language, sidebar preferences, log collection and data persistence policies, plus system runtime information.
page.help.rateLimit: Rate limiting strategy configuration. Bind to routes or clusters to take effect. Supports fixed window, sliding window, token bucket algorithms.
page.help.waf: WAF firewall configuration to block malicious requests. Protects against SQL injection, XSS, path traversal attacks.
page.help.retry: Request retry configuration. Automatically retries failed requests. Supports exponential backoff.
page.help.responseCache: Response cache configuration. Caches backend responses to accelerate subsequent requests.
page.help.serviceDiscovery: Service discovery configuration. Automatically discovers backend service nodes and updates cluster destinations.
page.help.compression: Response compression configuration. Automatically applies Gzip/Brotli compression to responses matching MIME types and exceeding minimum size.
page.help.rateLimitRedis: Redis-based distributed rate limiting for multi-instance gateway deployments, ensuring precise global limits.
page.help.traffic: Traffic monitoring shows real-time and historical request data, including QPS, error rate, latency metrics.
page.help.clusterMetrics: Cluster metrics show request volume, error rate, and node health for each cluster.
page.help.audit: Audit log records all configuration changes, including who, when, and what changed.
page.help.history: Config history records every configuration change version. Supports rollback to any historical version.
page.help.overview: Gateway maintenance dashboard overview showing clusters, routes, health status, and real-time traffic. Click stat cards to navigate to management pages.
